standard.coverage: All employers, regardless of size -- California's 25-or-fewer-employee tier ended after 2022.
standard.note: Labor Code 1182.12 annual CPI adjustment, capped at 3.5%. Governor's announcement of 2026-07-31: the statewide minimum wage increases to $17.40 per hour on 2027-01-01.

tipped.note: This state allows NO tip credit: the full state minimum wage must be paid in cash before any tips (Labor Code 351). The cash floor is therefore the announced statewide rate, $17.40, not a separately published tipped figure. The no-tip-credit rule itself is carried forward from CA-2026.json.

knownGaps: No 2027 local or sectoral minimum-wage files were added with this statewide update. The loader is year-keyed, so a 2027 check date does not fall back to local/CA-local-2026.json or sectoral/CA-sectoral-2026.json.
California has more local minimum wage ordinances than the rest of the country combined -- 38 of them, in local/CA-local-2026.json.
California also runs two SECTORAL minimum wages well above the state rate (fast food, health care) -- see sectoral/CA-sectoral-2026.json.

Exempt-employee salary thresholds (2x the state minimum wage annualized) and the separate computer-professional and licensed-physician exemptions are derived from, but not the same as, this rate; they are out of scope here.

$yearNote: 2027 statewide minimum wage only: $17.40/hr effective 2027-01-01. Local ordinances and sectoral rates were not copied forward. The no-tip-credit cash floor equals $17.40 because Labor Code 351 forbids a tip credit; that rule is carried from the 2026 file and applied to the new statewide rate. minimumWage() also loads data/minimum-wage/federal-2027.json, which carries the statutory FLSA floor so this rate can be compared with it. That federal file is not a 2027 withholding ruleset.
